meta.philosophy: Rotate the direction of your life. Let thousands of ordinary decisions accumulate in that direction. Not daily goals — phase rotations and environment substitutions.

phases.name: Capital Accumulation
phases.dailyFocus: Every pound saved is a point. Every hour of remote work is a point. Hindi is background input only.
phases.criticalAction: APPLY FOR AIU EQUIVALENCY CERTIFICATE NOW

phases.name: Hindi Fluency

environment.housing: BHU International Hostel — private room, Hindi-speaking environment
environment.media: Hindi first. Comprehensible Hindi → Hindi YouTube → Hindi comedy → native content
environment.social: Hindi first. Landlord, shops, friends, teachers — all Hindi.
environment.daily_life: Every interaction is Hindi practice. Zero English default.

phases.measurement: Not hours practiced — OBSERVED ABILITY. How long before English fallback? What vocabulary is being used?
phases.criticalAction: Tonight: replace English bedtime content with Comprehensible Hindi

phases.name: Scholarship — Sanskrit, Śaivism, BHU

environment.academic: MA Indian Philosophy & Religion. Primary texts. Sanskrit. Scholars.
environment.income: Background — remote work continues but is not the focus

phases.criticalAction: Deep reading of primary texts. Begin original interpretation.

phases.name: Estate — Farm + Scholarship + Business

environment.housing: Estate cottage — leased land, animals, garden, lab
environment.daily_rhythm: Farm routine + scholarship + business + AI-directed automation

phases.criticalAction: Run the estate. Grow the business. Deepen the scholarship. Ask AI to automate what's tedious.

currentPhase.hindi_status: background_input_only — evening content, not study sessions

keyPrinciple: You don't need to create new behaviors. You need to rotate which existing behavior is dominant. In Cambodia, money is dominant. In Varanasi, Hindi becomes dominant. At BHU, scholarship becomes dominant. At the estate, the life becomes dominant. The graph tracks the state. The phases rotate the attention.
